description: Reports how signafAIde is set up in this project and whether records are reaching the service. Call it to check that set-up worked, after signafaide_init, or when signafaide_verify or signafaide_flush reports a problem and you need to see why. Returns one line for each of: the API key (masked) and its env, or that there is none and records stay on this machine; the service URL; the project; the local state folder; every agent chain with its key id, record count and last receipt; any chain that is BLOCKED, with the reason and the next step; how many records wait in the outbox; the quota used; and, for a sandbox, the claim link with how long an unclaimed sandbox has left. Read-only: it sends no records and changes no code, record or key (it only saves what the service says about the sandbox's claim state in .signafaide/). It contacts the service only when an API key exists, to read the project, the quota and the claim state; without a key it makes no request. Use signafaide_records to list the records themselves, signafaide_flush to send the waiting ones, and signafaide_claim_link when the user only needs the claim link.

directory.description: Path of the project to work on: the folder the MCP server was started in, or one below it. Default: that folder.
